hero.badge: Live platform · GPS tracking & payments active
hero.desc: MoveSpot is the marketplace connecting advertisers and vehicle owners — food trucks, vans, taxis, ride-hail, delivery scooters. You draw your zone, the budget is calculated per km², and every kilometre broadcast is proven by GPS.
hero.stat0_v: per km² per day ($2.70 in major cities)
hero.stat1_v: per vehicle per day — from $375/month for 1 vehicle

features.item0_d: Draw your broadcast polygon; the area and budget are calculated automatically, with a density surcharge in urban areas.
features.item1_d: GPS positions sent in batches then aggregated: real kilometres, active minutes, and coverage rate for your zone.
features.item2_d: Card payment, subscription with a 14-day trial, prepaid wallet, or bank transfer for B2B budgets.
features.item3_d: SIRET-verified, signed vehicle QR codes, installation validated with 4 photos, two-factor auth, and human moderation.

map.desc: Overview of vehicle flows. On an active campaign, this map shows real-time positions, kilometres covered, and the share of the journey within your zone.
